chunks.text: I’m going to be in Guangzhou soon, and I’ve been thinking a lot about where we’ll eat since it’s a pretty big group.
And separately, I’ll be in Shanghai too, so I’ve been keeping an eye on what movies are out while I’m there.
Also, I’ve been meaning to check what to take for this annoying cough—like what medicine options make sense, since I don’t want it dragging on.
For the Guangzhou dinner, we’re doing Bingsheng Restaurant on 2026-05-21 at 20:00, and it’s a party of 8.
It’s under Hu Bin, and the contact number I’m using is 13855667788—just keeping it consistent with the rest of my plans.

In Shanghai I’m catching Dune 2 at CGV Longzhimeng, the 20:30 showtime—just one seat—and I’m putting it under Sarah Chen, and then after that I’ll probably swing by a pharmacy if my throat still feels scratchy…
